id: 20_Fundamentals of Handling Compressed Gas Cylinders Safely – Attaching the Regulat
title: 压缩气瓶安全操作基础：安装减压器
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/20_Fundamentals of Handling Compressed Gas Cylinders Safely – Attaching the Regulat.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/20_Fundamentals of Handling Compressed Gas Cylinders Safely – Attaching the Regulat/src.py

points.K2: 取下瓶帽，确认瓶阀关闭

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台边的一只气瓶旁，手里拿着减压器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a gas cylinder standing upright next to a lab bench, holding a pressure regulator with two round gauges, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲怎样给气瓶装上减压器。

shots.scene: 放大镜、关闭的阀门、手、扳手四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a magnifying glass, a closed valve, a hand, and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 先检查，再归零，手拧上，扳手紧。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一只减压器，伸手去拿老虎钳
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a pressure regulator in one hand and reaches for a pair of pliers on the bench with the other.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿起一只减压器，又抓起钳子。

shots.scene: 钳子夹螺母的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of pliers gripping a hex nut, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 想把它硬拧到气瓶上。

shots.scene: 小研拦住阿杰，指向气瓶标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student and points at the blank label on the gas cylinder.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：别急，先检查。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 装减压器，一步都不能省。

shots.scene: 小研拿着减压器，站在气瓶旁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves, stands beside the cylinder holding a regulator.
shots.narration: 上手之前，减压器和气瓶都要检查。

shots.section_title: 取下瓶帽，确认瓶阀关闭
shots.scene: 小研双手拧下瓶帽
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student unscrews the protective cap from the top of the cylinder with both hands.
shots.narration: 先取下瓶帽，露出瓶阀。
overlay: 取下瓶帽，确认瓶阀关闭

shots.section_title: 取下瓶帽，确认瓶阀关闭
shots.scene: 瓶阀旁的鼻子、眼睛、耳朵图标
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a closed cylinder valve with a nose icon, an eye icon and an ear icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有没有气味、气雾、嘶嘶声？

shots.section_title: 取下瓶帽，确认瓶阀关闭
shots.scene: 瓶阀图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A closed cylinder valve icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 都没有，说明瓶阀是关着的。

shots.scene: 放大镜下的减压器进气接头螺纹
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over the threaded inlet fitting of a pressure regulator. No people.
shots.narration: 检查减压器接头的螺纹。

shots.scene: 螺纹上的损伤、油污、灰尘三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three small icons beside the threads: a damaged thread, an oil drop and dust specks. No people.
shots.narration: 有损伤、油污、灰尘，都不能装。

shots.scene: 手顺时针转动减压器出口小阀，旁边顺时针箭头
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand turns the small outlet valve of the regulator, with a clockwise arrow beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 先把出口流量阀顺时针关上。

shots.scene: 手逆时针转动调压手轮，旁边逆时针箭头
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand turns the large adjusting knob of the regulator, with a counterclockwise arrow beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 再把调压手轮逆时针松到底。

shots.scene: 两个关闭状态的阀门图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two valve icons both shown in the closed position, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 这样开瓶时，气不会一下子冲出来。

shots.scene: 小研把减压器对准瓶阀出气口，用手旋入
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lines the regulator inlet up with the cylinder valve outlet and screws it in by hand.
shots.narration: 对准接口，先用手拧到手紧。

shots.scene: 接口歪斜卡住，旁边是停止手势图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a regulator fitting jammed at an angle on the valve outlet, with a stop hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 拧不进，就停手，别硬拧。

shots.scene: 减压器和气瓶之间出现问号
shots.prompt_en: A regulator icon and a cylinder icon with a large question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 配合不好，可能这只表不适合这种气。

shots.scene: 两个接口图标，一个逆时针箭头配火焰，一个顺时针箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two fitting icons side by side: one with a counterclockwise arrow and a flame pictogram, one with a clockwise arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃气体接口，逆时针拧紧。

shots.scene: 小研对着空白规程核对旋向
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares the fitting with a blank procedure card before turning it.
shots.narration: 不可燃气体，顺时针拧紧，先认准再拧。

shots.scene: 小研用开口扳手卡住接头螺母拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tightens the hex nut of the connection firmly with an open-end wrench.
shots.narration: 最后用开口扳手或固定扳手拧牢。

shots.scene: 火焰标志旁一把防火花扳手
shots.prompt_en: A flame pictogram next to a non-sparking wrench with a spark icon crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃气体，要用防火花的扳手。

shots.scene: 钳子被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A pair of pliers crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不得使用钳子。

shots.scene: 氧气瓶接头旁，油滴和油手套图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen cylinder fitting next to an oil drop icon and a greasy glove icon, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气减压器，螺纹上绝不能沾油脂。

shots.scene: 一卷白色密封带，旁边是问号和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A roll of white thread sealing tape with a question mark and a telephone icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 想缠密封带，先问厂家或供应商。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现瓶帽、瓶阀、放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a cylinder cap, a closed valve and a magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 取下瓶帽，确认阀关，查好螺纹。

shots.scene: 两个阀门归零、手拧、扳手三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: two closed valves, a hand turning a fitting and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 两阀关好，手拧到位，扳手拧牢。

shots.scene: 钳子、油滴两个图标被打叉，密封带旁一个问号
shots.prompt_en: Pliers and an oil drop crossed out with red X marks, and a roll of sealing tape with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不用钳子，氧气禁油，密封带先问。

shots.scene: 欣欣在装好减压器的气瓶旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside a gas cylinder with a regulator fitted.
shots.narration: 装好减压器，安全用气，下次见！
